name: MAJOR CONTENT
company: MAJOR CONTENT is a TV | Film production and literary management company whose work spans Emmy Award-winning programming and New York Times Bestselling books, focusing on unscripted and scripted series, features, documentaries, and non-fiction and fiction books.

Driven by the approach of being culturally inspired, but not culturally exclusive, MAJOR CONTENT leverages a track record of industry leadership and a distinctive sensibility in premium programming and major trade publishing to help shape and elevate universal content for global audiences.
MAJOR CONTENT takes a holistic approach to storytelling—transcending the confines of a single show, movie, or book.

tvFilm.label: TV | FILM
tvFilm.body: Major Content develops and produces scripted and unscripted series, features, and documentaries, with credits spanning premium cable, broadcast, and streaming platforms. Several of its projects are inspired by or adapted from bestselling books, drawing directly on the synergy between publishing and production to build marquee properties.

books.label: BOOKS
books.body: Major Content represents adult non-fiction and children's fiction by industry-leading and celebrity authors, whose stories have the potential of becoming compelling television. Major Content brings a proven editorial and marketing sensibility to pair luminary authors with today's top publishing houses.

founder.name: Raymond Garcia
bio: Raymond Garcia is the Founder and CEO of Major Content, drawing on a distinguished track record across premium television, publishing, and global brands.

As Executive Producer, Garcia's credits include the Emmy Award-winning Drive with Swizz Beatz (Hulu), Time of Essence (OWN/HBO Max), Remix My Space with Marsai Martin (HBO Max), and Ricky Martin: Behind the Vegas Residency (Paramount). Literary representation includes New York Times bestselling authors Marco Borges (The Greenprint, foreword by Jay-Z and Beyoncé) and Emme Muñiz (Lord Help Me).

Garcia previously founded and served as Publisher of Celebra at Penguin Random House, establishing a premier celebrity publishing imprint with an extensive list of New York Times and international bestselling authors, including Jennifer Lopez, Ricky Martin, Gloria and Emilio Estefan, Rita Moreno, La La Anthony, Mario Lopez, Victor Cruz, Pelé, Thalía, Tommy Mottola, Angie Martinez, George Lopez, and Juanes, among many others.

Earlier, Garcia served as Associate Publisher and Marketing Director of Rayo at HarperCollins and founded REG Brands, whose work included pioneering multicultural marketing campaigns with TIME Inc. and expanding the Celia Cruz brand into an international licensing property.
founder.recognition: Garcia was named one of People en Español's 50 Most Influential Hispanics—one of only three honorees from the business sector and the sole representative from book publishing.
founder.careerLine: Founder and Publisher of Celebra | Penguin Random House. Associate Publisher and Marketing Director of Rayo | HarperCollins. Executive Producer across Hulu, OWN, HBO Max, Discovery+, and VH1.
